name: WdHighAnsiText
description: Specifies how Word interprets high-ANSI text.

constants.name: wdHighAnsiIsFarEast
constants.description: Word doesn't interpret any high-ANSI text as East Asian characters.

constants.name: wdHighAnsiIsHighAnsi
constants.description: Word interprets all high-ANSI text as East Asian characters.

constants.name: wdAutoDetectHighAnsiFarEast
constants.description: Microsoft Word interprets high-ANSI text as East Asian characters only if Word automatically detects East Asian language text.
